questions.question: How are the righteous told to praise the LORD in Psalm 33?
options: With silence and stillness and quiet and patient waiting
With the lyre, harp, and a new song, playing skillfully
With sackcloth and ashes and a loud and mournful cry
With incense and sacrifice and solemn, sacred feasts
questions.answer: With the lyre, harp, and a new song, playing skillfully

questions.question: How were the heavens made, according to Psalm 33?
options: By the wisdom of the ages
By the labor of many days
By the hand of an angel
By the word of the LORD
questions.answer: By the word of the LORD
